name: Coral Claw

bible.design: Dog-sized crab, pink/orange branching coral, wet teal legs, one much larger claw.

lockedIdentity: Large anatomical right claw: viewer-left from the front, viewer-right from behind.
Two claw-bearing arms and eight walking legs; claw arms are not walking legs.
Four walking-leg chains per body side, indexed front to rear for animation continuity.
Rigid shell, coral branch bases and leg segments retain their shape.

clips.idle: Small eyestalk and claw-finger movement with planted walking feet.
clips.walk: Sideways scuttle with alternating planted and lifted leg groups; preserve individual leg identity.
clips.attack: Large claw opens, reaches and pinches, then returns; body supported by walking legs.
clips.hit: Short shell recoil with bracing bent legs and retracted eyestalks.
clips.death: Walking knees buckle under shell, body lowers, claws relax on ground; no backward flip.

blockingArtIssues: Original front and profile references do not expose eight individually traceable walking-leg chains.
Coral branch topology and small-claw decoration differ between views.
next: Review front-rest-study.png and walk-front-study.png for planted-foot continuity and hidden attachment order. Reconcile back/profiles and preserve rigid coral before final animation.
